nodes.summary: Pull-request checklist prompting contributors to explain changes and motivation, report verification results, confirm security and documentation checks, and attach screenshots for UI changes.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Generated, fully commented ignore-pattern template for controlling future Understand Anything scans, including project artifacts, caches, documentation, examples, and language-specific test conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses gitignore-compatible syntax, but all project-specific suggestions remain commented and therefore inactive.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Configures Understand Anything graph generation to produce English textual output.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Brief backend overview identifying the FastAPI API and Python CLI and directing readers to the main project guide for setup, usage, testing, and deployment.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Marks the backend application-service directory as an importable Python package.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Defines Python 3.12 package metadata, runtime and development dependencies, the azero CLI entry point, setuptools packaging, pytest behavior, Ruff formatting limits, and mypy settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 621 project metadata and setuptools, with separate pytest, Ruff, and mypy tool sections.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Marks the backend test suite as an importable Python package.

nodes.name: sample-idea.json
nodes.summary: Complete example validation brief for a privacy-first, on-device legal meeting summarizer, covering customer, problem, solution, economics, founder constraints, channels, competitors, assumptions, and regulation.

nodes.name: postcss.config.js
nodes.summary: Configures PostCSS to process frontend styles with Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Defines global Tailwind layers, typography and page defaults, reusable cards, buttons, inputs, badges, navigation and depth effects, ambient animations, responsive behavior, reduced-motion accessibility, and print styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines Tailwind directives and @apply composition with custom keyframes, motion-reduction overrides, and print-specific rules.

nodes.name: DocsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the founder documentation page with navigation and detailed guidance on briefing, research depth, evidence interpretation, a 30-day validation playbook, metrics, CLI commands, and frequently asked questions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a large declarative React component with mapped content tables and reusable local section and code-block renderers.

nodes.name: DocsPage
nodes.summary: Builds the complete interactive documentation and founder playbook page from structured navigation, guidance, reference, and FAQ content.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.js
nodes.summary: Configures Tailwind content discovery and extends the frontend theme with surface, card, border, Verseo palette, and sans, display, and monospace font families.

nodes.name: docs.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Vitest component test that renders the documentation page in a memory router and verifies the business playbook, CLI reference, and interview milestone content.

nodes.name: setup.ts
nodes.summary: Loads DOM-aware Testing Library matchers into the frontend Vitest environment.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Configures Vite with React, a development server on port 5173, an API proxy to the local backend, and a jsdom Vitest environment using the shared test setup.
